data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出基于消融显著性的 Harness 剪枝，以性能和 token 成本反馈删除模块；剪枝后的 Harness 在留出集保持性能，属可复用工件改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: estimate the saliency of each module by ablating it and assessing its task performance and token cost relative to the full set of single-module ablations
scope_support.object_quote: we study harness pruning as a means of striking a better balance between task performance and token cost
scope_support.persistence_quote: most harnesses that we studied are highly redundant and can maintain comparable performance and efficiency even after a substantial portion of their modules are pruned
